sections.text:
Vertigo on stooping; throbbing after eating,
pressure in temples and forehead.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Dry cough; worse at night and lying
down ; larynx painful. Chronic bronchitis ; cough, with
much thick expectoration, with languor and weak di-
gestion. Stitches behind sternum. Teasing cough with
much and free expectoration.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Menses too early and painful. Labor-like
pains; urging to stool; dragging in genitals, with vio-

tering of teeth from cold during menstruation. Mov-

sections.label: Rectum
sections.text:
Pressing toward rectum as of something
extruding.

sections.label: Urinary
sections.text:
Frequent urging to urinate; passes only in
drops. Violet odor. [Tereb.]

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Pain in right shoulder and wrist ; tear-
ing in left palm, unable to double fingers ; pain in lower
limbs, feet and ankles.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Crocus; Ignatxa; Anim
dracontium (loose cough worse at night on lying down).

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Pupils, dilated; contract unequally, react
poorly. Diplopia. Failing sight due to retro-bulbar
neuritis, central scotoma — partial atrophy of optic disc.

sections.label: Chest
sections.text:
Sore pain in apex of right lung. Feeling of
a weight on chest, as if smothering. Cough and wheez-
ing on going to bed. Pain in left breast, like a hand
grasping at the base of the heart. Haemoptysis. Asth-
matic breathing.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Confusion of the whole head, with nausea rising from the
stomach, in the evening (first day). — ^Vertigo, on stooping (after three
hours). — Rush of blood to the head causes sleeplessness for two nights. —
Tearing, throbbing pain in the forehead and whole top of the head, after
eating (second day). — ^Burrowing headache in the left temple, in a spot as
large as a thaler, in the evening (first day). — Headache in the right side,
afterwards in the left (second day). — Sticking headache in the right side
(second day). — Jerking, tearing pain in the occiput, afterwards extending
to the left side of the occiput, towards the ear.

Eye. — [10.] Twitching in both upper lids, momentary, so that she was
obliged to press the eyes together (after eight hours). — Burning in the left
eyeball (after twenty-one hours). — Swimming before the eyes, and pressure
in the temples and forehead.

Ear. — Dull stitches in the left ear, with transient sticking above the
right eyebrow, in the evening (first day).

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Stitches in the right side of the middle of the nose (after four
hours). — Sticking crawling in the root of the nose, extending to the eye-
brows, lasting several minutes (twentieth day).

sections.label: Face
sections.text:
Left side of the face red and hot, a white spot near the nose
(eighth hour).

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Teeth. Pain in all the hollow teeth, at times through the
whole proving, alternately coming and going for twenty-six days, mostly
at night when waking, not only in the teeth but also in the gum. — Very
transient, violent boring in the first left hollow back teeth, in the evening
(second day). — Itching, throbbing, hammering in the left upper and lower
jaw, in two hollow back teeth, every night about 11 o'clock (from eighth to
thirty-third day). — General Mouth. [20.] Dryness of the mouth (in
two provers), (after a quarter of an hour). — Dryness of the mouth, with
scraping and tickling in the throat, so that swallowing was difficult ; nausea
in the stomach, at 7 a.m. (second day). — Taste. Taste as of violet root in
the mouth (after two hours).

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
On swallowing, pain in the throat, which seems swollen,
lasting through the night till morning. — Tickling in the throat causing
constant cough (thirteenth and fourteenth days).

Stotnach. — (Her usual nausea in the morning, coming from the
stomach, disappeared), (after second day). — Twisting as with a ball in the
epigastric region, above the umbilicus.— Sticking pain in the epigastric re-
gion (after six hours).

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Hypochondria. Violent motion internally beneath
the right hypochoudrium, as though something living were moving about,
during menstruation (after eighteen days). — Umhilical. Sticking as
with two pins to the right of the umbilicus (after three hours). — General

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
[30.] A feeling in the abdomen as though menstruation would
occur (seven days after menstruation), (after twenty-four days). — Movings
about the abdomen as if menstruation would occur (ten days after menstrua-
tion).— Movings about in the abdomen, as at the appearance of menstruation,
followed by yellowish leucorrhoea (fifth day). — Rumbling in the abdomen (in
two provers), (after half an hour). — Rumbling and fermentation in the abdo-
men, immediately. — Pain in the abdomen with very profuse leucorrhoea,

[40.] Griping in the abdomen, with ineffectual urging to stool
(twenty-ninth day). — Mypoffastrium. Sticking pain in a small spot
as large as a thaler, between the umbilicus and right groin, as from a knife,
lasting two days (after thirteen days). — Stitches in the left side of the ab-
domen, towards the left groin (after fourteen days). — A stitch in the region
of the right groin, extending to the umbilicus, on every step.

Rectum and Anus. — Pressing dragging towards the rectum and
genitals, as in labor ; as if a substance would come out, occurring repeatedly
(from two to thirty days). — Urging to stool, with cutting pain, not followed
by stool (after twenty-three days). — Urging to stool, followed by a large
pasty stool with griping about the umbilicus, in the evening (second day).

sections.label: Stool
sections.text:
Diarrhoea for two days and one night. — Stools small, numerous,
burning, with urging, very unusual (after twenty-four days). — Stool yel-
low, pasty, scanty, like an infant's, with urging, without pain (twenty-first
day). — [50.] Stools hard, was obliged to press them out (twenty-fourth
day).

JJi'lnavy Organs. — Urging to urinate ten times in one hour; the
urine passes by drops (second day). — The urine smells of violets.

Sexual Organs. — Pain in the uterus, with pain in the small of the
back, very violent, with pressure as in labor ; urging to stool, which she dreads;
she is obliged to remain lying. — Stitching in the region of the uterus (after
five hours). — Stitches in the uterus as with a fork, lasting several minutes,
in the evening (after nine hours, first day). — Dragging in the genitals, with
more violent backache than she had ever had before (in an unmarried girl),
(second day). — Stitches at times in the pudenda (twenty-ninth day). —
Three stitches in succession in the genitals (second and sixth days). — Men-
struation five days too early (after sixteen days). — [60.] Menstruation five
days too early, preceded by colic for three days ; everything in the abdo-
men is gathered into a lump (in two female provers), (after thirty-five
days). — Menstruation three to six days too early, with colic, especially at
night. — Menstruation three days too early, preceded by pain for two days. —
Menstruation delayed one day (after twelve days). — Paroxysmal clotted
discharge during the first days of menstruation.

Itespiratory Organs.— K child was attacked with cough (second
day).— Dry cough, with constant tickling in the pit of the throat, difficult
breathing, and a sensation as though hoarseness would occur (after two
days).

'CJiest.—V&m below the right ribs, with heat of the right cheek (after
nine days).— Stitches beneath the left, seventh, and eighth ribs, lasting
half an hour (after one hour and a half).— Throbbing, jerking pain, as
from suppuration, in the middle of the chest (second day).— [70.] Transient
stitches behind the sternum, aggravated by motion (after four hours).—
Pain in the right side of the chest, especially towards the shoulder, during
menstruation (after twenty days).— Pain in the nipple (after eight days).

jBaC'fc.— Pain through the back and chest, on inspiration (after five

trembling of the whole body, and chattering of the teeth from cold (after

the nates (second day). — [90.] Sticking in the right hip, extending through

Spasmodic sticking pain beneath the bend of the right knee, with heat of

night in sleep. — Drawing pain, beginning in the forepart of the right leg,
extending from the knee up to the right groin and ending behind the arch

eight days). — Sharp stitches in the left side of the left malleolus, transient
(after fifty-four hours). — Stitches, as with needles, in the right heel (ninth
day). — Sticking pain in the two middle toes of the right foot, extending to
the middle of the sole, afterwards in the heel, lasting two days.

General Sf/mptoms. — Sensation as though some one were poking
him with the finger, in various parts of the body, especially in the diaphragm,
which was so painful that he awoke and was obliged to clench his teeth.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
[100.] Itching, as from fleas, here and there. — Violent itching
on the lower limbs, during menstruation, with burning after scratching, in
bed (sixteenth day).

Sleep and Dreams. — Sleeplessness, starting and crying out in sleep ;
restless and anxious sleep only towards morning (in a child of two years). —
Sleep bad, with a feeling in the morning as if the head were confused. —
Lascivious dreams (twentieth day). — Disgusting dreams, in the morning
(second day).

sections.label: Fever
sections.text:
Coldness; shaking in bed, as in the paroxysms of fever, with
cold blue hands and nails, and without heat, thirst and sweat. — Transient
flushing of heat in the face (twenty-third day). — Glowing heat of the left
cheek (after six hours).

Conditions. — Aggravation, — {Night), About 11 o'clock, itching, etc.,
in back teeth ; colic. — {After eating), Pain in forehead, etc. — {Inspiration),
Pain through back, etc. — {Motion), Pain in chest. — ( When walking about).
Pain in abdomen.

Amelioration. — {Pressure), Tearing in hand.
